summary: Block 16B is at UCSF's Mission Bay North Campus. UCSF's June 2025 presentation lists Blocks 16A and B as undeveloped research parcels with 'no building plans at Mission Bay right now'; UCSF's May 2026 approval of a five-level ear and hearing building covers Block 16A and 'a portion of Block 16B'. A UCSF Preliminary Utilities Plant already stands on Block 16B (per UCSF's 2017 environmental addendum), so the block is not wholly undeveloped.

milestones.text: UCSF's Addendum #4 (Weill Neurosciences Building) refers to 'the existing Preliminary Utilities Plant on Block 16B', which the new building's utility loop would connect to; it also recounts temporary contractor parking analysed for Blocks 15 and 16 in a September 13, 2016 Note to File

UCSF's Mission Bay CAC presentation lists 'Block 16A & B – Research' among undeveloped parcels remaining 'per UCSF's Long Range Development Plan' and states 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'

The University of California approves the Mission Bay Block 16A Building on 'Block 16A and a portion of Block 16B' (Notice of Determination); UCSF's release forecasts construction from late 2026, completion in 2029 and occupancy in 2030 (see the Block 16A record)
